message.content:
This portrait-format illustration is the cover of a magazine. The background is solid white on the left and pink on the lower right. The masthead "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large, serif, red capital letters. Above it, red text reads "PENANGKAPAN NOVEL BASWEDAN" and "SETELAH PETRAL DIBUBARKAN," separated by a thin gray diagonal line. The date "4-10 MEI 2015" appears in small black font under the "O."

The central figure is a profile illustration of a person's head and neck, facing left. The person has dark brown hair, closed eyes with puffy lids, a prominent nose, and full lips. A small dark mole is on the lower jaw. The skin is rendered in shades of pink, purple, and beige. On the left, a single red bullet floats horizontally in front of the person’s nose.

In the bottom-left corner, red and black text reads "MARY JANE VELOSO TERJERAT KARTEL NARKOTIK" above smaller black text "Investigasi Tempo sampai Nueva Ecija, Filipina." The bottom-right corner contains a barcode, the price "RP 39.500," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO."
